title: Governance report: unattended-run denials and dispatch runs attributed to their flow

AC1.note: Verified against origin/main merge commit ac0f1d40 (PR #659): keryx governance report reads TriggerDispatchRecord.denials from the ledger and lists them per trigger/run (tool, reason, time) under each flow's dispatch section; interactive-session policy decisions remain reported as not recorded with the narrower reason (src/governance/aggregate.ts POLICY_DECISIONS_NOT_RECORDED). Pinned by src/governance/report.test.ts's denial-attribution test.

AC2.note: A dispatch run naming a flow+task is attributed to that flow (spend+outcome shown under FlowGovernance.dispatch); trigger runs without a flow stay project-level. Ledger schema change confirmed additive: dispatch.flow/.task on reserved records and OpenReservation.flow/.task are optional TS fields, and parseRecord (unchanged, pre-existing on main) does loose duck-typed validation with only at/trigger/outcome required -- an older keryx reads a newer ledger line fine. Review finding on this AC (project spend AND flow spend double-counting the same dollar) fixed in 8b61b788, verified via review-verification pass 2026-09-23-review-297 (disposition acted-on).

AC3.note: src/governance/aggregate.ts's POLICY_DECISIONS_NOT_RECORDED reason no longer calls flow 290 a future source; states unattended dispatch denials ARE recorded and surfaced per-flow. Pinned by test in report.test.ts asserting the reason text.

AC5.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md's governance report section documents the new Dispatch runs / Open reservations sections per flow, plus (fix 8b61b788) the attributedToFlowsUsd / includedInProjectTriggerSpend non-additivity note. Verified at merge commit ac0f1d40.

AC6.note: gh pr checks 659: 18/18 passed, 0 failed. keryx health run at merge commit ac0f1d40: PASS, project score 94, no gate conditions triggered.

AC4.note: src/governance/report.test.ts's fixture-ledger tests cover: a dispatch run with denials (AC1/AC2 test), an open spend reservation (AC2/AC4 test), a report-only flow-next run staying project-level (AC4 test), and a pre-change record with no dispatch field reading fine. Plus the new non-additivity regression test for the double-count fix. bun test src/governance/report.test.ts: 27 pass, 0 fail at merge commit ac0f1d40.
